default.description: Grants the frontend the core event APIs. Without any capability file Tauri v2 denies every core plugin command, which silently broke `listen('open-file')` — the channel the OS "Open With SeeNote" handoff uses when the app is already running (see src-tauri/src/lib.rs and hooks/useOsOpenFile.ts). Everything else the frontend calls is an app-defined command, which the ACL does not gate.
